headline: HRL advertises cryogenic-CMOS model correlation and UVM-AMS verification leadership
fact: HRL Laboratories' Qubit Systems Laboratory posted an AMS verification role for quantum-control cryogenic CMOS. It assigns Verilog-A/AMS, wreal and SV-RNM models aligned with transistor-level implementations; UVM-AMS environments, SVA/PSL and coverage; regression infrastructure; and block-to-top-level integration for ADCs, DACs, PLLs, LDOs, SerDes and power-management blocks. Model correlation spans PVT/corner simulation and later measurements. The employer identifies HRL as an IBM company. These are advertised responsibilities, not demonstrated model accuracy.

sources.title: HRL Careers: Analog/Mixed Signal Verification Engineer, Qubit Systems Laboratory
sources.summary: Official employer page and JobPosting datePosted identify October 6, 2026. Full text names cryogenic CMOS, RNM/Verilog-A/AMS, UVM-AMS, transistor-model alignment, assertions and regression/CI ownership; the page identifies HRL as an IBM company.
